name: io.github.yjcho9317/nworks
description: CLI and MCP server for NAVER WORKS / LINE WORKS — messages, calendar, drive, mail, tasks, and boards for AI agents (Claude, Cursor).

environmentVariables.name: NWORKS_CLIENT_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: OAuth Client Secret issued in the LINE WORKS Developer Console.

environmentVariables.name: NWORKS_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: OAuth Client ID. Optional if already stored via `nworks login`.

environmentVariables.name: NWORKS_SERVICE_ACCOUNT
environmentVariables.description: Service Account ID for bot messaging (e.g. xxxx.serviceaccount@domain).

environmentVariables.name: NWORKS_PRIVATE_KEY_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Path to the Service Account private key (.key) used to sign the JWT.

environmentVariables.name: NWORKS_BOT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Bot ID required to send messages.
